# Java Audiveris 5.11 (Temurin JDK 25.0.3+9 LTS) STEMS head-stump oracle.
#
# Every target starts a fresh JVM and reaches real HEADS. The probe then
# executes the exact constructor prefix of StemsRetriever.inspectStems:
# purged seeds, stable-x BeamLinkers with tremolo removal, then stable-x
# HeadLinkers. No VLinker or CLinker inspection is performed.
#
# Head corners use constructor order TL, BL, TR, BR. seed/built/none is
# validated by object identity. Independent build rows freeze the stump area,
# lag input and stable distance order, pre-add, every width-gated compound step,
# subsection extraction, fixed glyph pixels, stands-out gate, registration/reuse
# ordinal, and returned/rejected result. Rejected glyph registrations remain visible.
#
# pre:N and reg:N are page-system-local boundary ordinals, never Java IDs.
# stumpAlias and buildAlias expose identity aliasing in first-corner order.
# The runner uses Epsilon GC so rejected weak-only originals remain observable
# and cannot introduce collector-timing-dependent registration/reuse rows.
# Doubles include hex text/raw bits. FNV-1a-64 hashes cover canonical UTF-8
# semantic rows with trailing newlines; the runner adds SHA-256 commitments.
